policy: Both arms inherit the trigger readout. At the first training-only native proposal within 240 ms of the marked word tail, else the largest five-step sum over that interval, read 360 ms later. Same seven balanced name families and seeds, same original anchors and teacher posteriors. Compare two copies of the intact window to one intact plus one with speech from the synthesizer's first command phone muted.
